0/2000A 1 / 5 PagesView full catalog Spectroradiometer CS-2000/2000A Product catalog summary Overview: The CS-2000 and CS-2000A are high-end spectroradiometers designed for high accuracy and stability in measuring luminance and chromaticity.
They are suitable for a wide range of applications, including display panels, small light sources, and distant lights.
Applications: The spectroradiometers are ideal for use as reference instruments in various industrial fields and can be used for evaluating projectors, LED, and EL lighting.
Illuminance spectroradiometer CS-2000A-I (customized product) The CS-2000A-I is an accurate illuminance spectroradiometer ideal for evaluating projectors and LED or EL lighting.
